scenarios.expectation: All criteria documented, high-quality evidence → auto-submit on approval.

scenarios.label: One gap — needs strengthening
scenarios.expectation: Mandatory met, a supporting criterion undocumented → back to the clinician.

scenarios.label: Mandatory criterion missing — human review
scenarios.expectation: No physiotherapy evidenced → the Critic blocks and a reviewer must decide.

scenarios.label: Denied — appeal with winning precedents
scenarios.expectation: Denial on record; two comparable cases won on appeal → precedent-backed appeal, human-approved.

scenarios.label: Denied — the Critic challenges an over-reaching appeal
scenarios.expectation: Comparable cases won, but only one of three criteria is evidenced → the Critic flags that the appeal recommendation is firmer than the record supports; the reviewer is steered to request evidence, not file.

scenarios.label: Thin record, no precedent — the system abstains
scenarios.expectation: Rarer procedure with no comparable history and low-quality evidence → the system declines to advise.

precedents.narrative: Patient completed eight weeks of physiotherapy with radiculopathy documented on examination and imaging expected to change management. Initially denied under MN-01 (conservative treatment not evidenced); authorised on appeal under clause 2.1.
